parameter.name: encryptionConfigKey
parameter.description: Fallback only. The recipient's public key store normally arrives as configKey on the stage.

parameter.name: signingConfigKey
parameter.description: Name of the PGP Private Key connection to sign with.

parameter.name: resumeSecret
parameter.description: Key material, at least 16 characters, from the secure vault. The session key, its IV and the signature nonce are all derived from it, which is what makes an interrupted transfer resumable. Keep it the same on every node that may resume the transfer.

parameter.name: passphrase
parameter.description: Overrides the passphrase held by the signing connection. Use a secure expression.

parameter.name: symmetricKeyAlgorithm
parameter.description: AES_256 (default), AES_192, AES_128, CAMELLIA_256, CAMELLIA_192, CAMELLIA_128, TWOFISH, CAST5, TRIPLE_DES, BLOWFISH, IDEA.

parameter.name: compressionAlgorithm
parameter.description: Off unless set. ZLIB, ZIP, BZIP2 or UNCOMPRESSED (default). Compressed output is only reproducible on a matching runtime; see pgpStreamEncrypt.

parameter.name: armor
parameter.description: ASCII-armor the output. true or false (default).

parameter.name: integrityCheck
parameter.description: Add an integrity (MDC) packet. true (default) or false.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Optional file name embedded in the literal-data packet.
